description: This file defines the Java interface `Range<T>` in the package `org.apache.ofbiz.base.lang`. It declares methods related to range operations such as inclusion, overlap, comparison, and retrieval of range endpoints. This interface is used to model a range of values in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Checks if this range occurs after another range or a specific value.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Checks if this range occurs before another range or a specific value.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns the ending value of this range.

methods.name: includes
methods.description: Determines if this range includes another range or a specific value.

methods.name: isPoint
methods.description: Checks if the start and end points of the range are equal.

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Checks if this range overlaps with another range.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns the starting value of this range.
